look_here_first: LOOK FIRST at the mature anthocarp: it is glabrous with five broadly rounded ribs and smooth grooves (sulci). Next inspect the relatively large petaloid perianth (about 4–7 mm) and usually five exserted stamens. Narrow leaves alone are not diagnostic.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Opposite narrow linear to lanceolate leaves on a perennial with branching stems; vegetative shape alone can overlap congeners.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Mature anthocarps about 2.5–3.5 mm, glabrous, broadly rounded ribs and smooth sulci.

key_traits.label: Identification
key_traits.text: Perianth about 4–7 mm, usually five stamens projecting beyond it; confirm reproductive structures rather than flower color.
